ctx.x: This is essentially a version of The World's Greatest Jazz Band, isn't it?
Yes, it is. Most of the guys on here were with The World's Greatest Jazz Band, except Bernie Privin, of course, and Bernie Layton. Bob Wilber, you know -- it was his date.
